exampleEn: You need to draw the line at excessive working hours.
exampleKo: 너는 과도한 근무 시간에서 한계를 설정해야 해.
gameExamples: It's important to draw the line when it comes to personal space.
As a teacher, I have to draw the line to maintain discipline in the classroom.
In friendships, you must draw the line at disrespectful behavior.
